title: OmniProject deployment profile
description: A deployment's CONTEXT posture — it adjusts the couplings the gateway would otherwise make mandatory (TLS expectation, no-IdP severity) and carries the setup picker's per-audience preset. One file per profile under assets/deployment-profiles/<id>.json. Data, not code, so a new profile type ships as JSON.

order.description: Display order in the picker (strict → relaxed).

default.description: The profile chosen when none is set (exactly one asset should carry this).

audience.description: Who this profile is for (shown in the setup picker).

tls.description: Does the profile assume the gateway is served over HTTPS?

demoAuthSeverity.description: Default severity of running without an IdP (demo auth = everyone admin).

relaxes.description: What the profile relaxes vs the strict baseline (for the picker).

presetEnv.description: Suggested env to set for this customer type (the preset).

recommend.description: What we'd recommend an operator on this profile do next.
